title: Use for travel
text: Use for travel. I know people use their ipads and such for movie viewing now... but honestly I travel a lot and I couldn't keep all the movies on my notepad... so I bought this utilize DVD's I already own.  I own another one that doesn't have a handle and I find myself using this one the most.  It is not overly large, not super well padded, but so far, no breakage.  I would recommend it.
